out_items.name: Hands clean and properly washed

violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: Employee observed washing dirty dishes and then handling clean dishes without washing hands prior.
violations.corrective_action: Corrected by instruction. ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: The handwashing facility located at the bar observed blocked, preventing access by employees for easy handwashing. Several things observed in hand sink per completely covering the hand sink and preventing access.
violations.corrective_action: All items moved out of hand sink. A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use.

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Soap dispenser at the hand sink next to the three-compartment sink observed old and dried out, incapable of being used.
violations.corrective_action: Dispenser was cleaned and new soap was added. Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands.

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Paper towel a the hand sink next to the three-compartment sink observed not working.
violations.corrective_action: Employee fixed the dispenser. Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing.

out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: containers of raw shrimp observed on top of boxes of corn in the walk-in.
violations.corrective_action: Corrected by relocating. Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to-eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc.

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: sour cream on counter (1hr) observed at room temperature.
violations.corrective_action: Sour cream was relocated to refrigerator for rapid cooling. Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: Time as a Public Health Control, Written Procedures
violations.observation: The person in charge is not able to provide written procedures for the use of time as a public health control with the following time/temperature control for safety food item(s): Cooked corn and potatoes are left on counter without temperature control and without written procedures or time marking.
violations.corrective_action: EHS will email Time as a Public Health Control procedures to CFM. Both had been prepared about an hour prior to inspection. Both containers must be used within 4hours of cooking. Please follow the TPHC procedures. If time only is used as a public health control for a working supply of time/temperature control for safety food before cooking or for ready to eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that is displayed or held for service for immediate consumption, written procedures shall be prepared in advance and maintained in the food establishment and made available to the regulatory authority upon request. Ocean Crab (Inspection Date: 09/30/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Bottle of unknown chemical observed without a label.
violations.corrective_action: Bottle contents were discarded. Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials.

out_items.name: Approved thawing methods used

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: Container of bagged frozen food observed stored in container of standing water at room temperature.
violations.corrective_action: Container of food was placed under running water at 70F or below.Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Containers of food observed stored on the floor and stored less than 6 inches off the floor in the walk-in freezer, walk-in cooler and in kitchen (oil/margarine)
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Sanitizer bucket observed with less than 10ppm for Chlorine/bleach.
violations.corrective_action: Corrected by dumping solution and making new. 100ppm observed. Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Cutting Board, When to Resurface or Discard
violations.observation: Two cutting boards observed heavily scratched and scored (stored at three-comp. Sink area). The food contact surface is no longer easily cleaned and sanitized due to condition.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces such as cutting blocks and boards that are subject to scratching and scoring shall be resurfaced if they can no longer be effectively cleaned and sanitized, or discarded if they are not capable of being resurfaced.

out_items.name: Certified Food Protection Manager

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. OBSERVED NO CFM ON SITE AT START OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. CFM ARRIVED DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE A CFM IS ON SITE DURING ALL HOURS OF OPERATION INCLUDING DURING PREPARATION.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the END OF 3 COMPARTMENT SINK being used TO STORE UTENSILS.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC REMOVED UTENSILS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE HANDWASH SINKS ARE USED ONLY FOR HANDWASHING.

out_items.name: Proper hot holding temperatures

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: POTATOES AT 123F ON STOVE TOP; MARINARA SAUCE AT 118F AND GARLIC BUTTER AT 112F IN STEAM TABLE.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO REHEAT FOODS TO 165F OR ABOVE FOR HOT HOLDING AT 135F OR ABOVE.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous and toxic materials are not properly labeled with a common name: SPRAY BOTTLES WITH CLEANING CHEMICALS IN BACK KITCHEN WITHOUT LABELS.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. OBSERVED OILS STORED DIRECTLY ON FLOOR IN KITCHEN; BOXES OF BEVERAGES STORED DIRECTLY ON FLOOR IN BAR AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE PROVIDE APPROVED SHELVING OR DUNNAGE RACKS TO ELEVATE FOODS AT LEAST 6 INCHES OFF THE FLOOR.

out_items.name: In-use utensils properly stored

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: RICE SCOOP IN WATER AT 94F; KNIVES STORED BETWEEN PREP TOP.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC REMOVED UTENSILS FOR CLEANING AND SANITIZING BEFORE STORING ON DRY, SANITIZED SURFACES. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: Open drinking containers used or stored in a manner that may contaminate food, food contact surfaces or utensils. OBSERVED BEVERAGE CONTAINER WITHOUT LID ON KITCHEN PREP COUNTER NEAR FRYERS.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may have beverages in the kitchen areas as long as they are covered and consumed through a straw and stored in a manner that will prevent contamination to food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO PLACE COVER ON COUNTER AND USE STRAW IN FOOD PREPARATION AREAS.

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: A food employee was observed eating AND drinking in areas where they may contaminate food, clean equipment, utensils or other items needing protection: IN FOOD PREPARATION AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may only eat, drink, or use tobacco in a designated area like a dining room or office area. Employees shall not eat or drink in the kitchen areas, warewashing areas, or storage areas where items may become contaminated. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO REMOVE FOODS FROM PREP AREA AND EAT AND DRINK IN DINING ROOM OR OTHER DESIGNATED AREA.

violations.observation: Surfaces of ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment are not being cleaned as required. OBSERVED ICE MACHINE WITH ACCUMULATION OF DISCOLORED SUBSTANCES ON INNER SURFACES.

out_items.name: Proper date marking and disposition

violations.title: RTE TCS Commercially Processed Food, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is commercially processed is not used or discarded within 24 hours of when the original container was opened and is not observed to be date marked: CLAM CHOWDER AND GUMBO IN DUKERS 3 DOOR PREP TOP.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety commercially processed foods when opened and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of the original container was opened. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. This date cannot exceed any manufacturer determined 'use-by' date based on food safety. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC APPLIED APPROPRIATE DATE MARKING DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food, Disclosure
violations.observation: The following raw and/or undercooked foods are provided on the menu, menu board, table tent or brochure without proper disclosure: OYSTERS SERVED RAW OR UNDERCOOKED ON MAIN AND DRINK MENUS WITH DISCLOSURE STATEMENT AND ASTERISKS “*” IDENTIFYING THE OYSTERS.
violations.corrective_action: The Consumer Advisory shall include a disclosure statement that includes a description of the animal-derived foods as raw/undercooked or identification of the animal-derived foods by asterisking (*) them to a footnote that states that the items are served raw or undercooked, or contain raw or undercooked ingredients. EDUCATION PROVIDED. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.
